Level transition ETCS ⇄ HTC

Now:
Announce m before the border
Like in real life: the transition is announced, the driver must acknowledge in the last 300 m, and at the border the train switches level. Not acknowledged: service brake until you acknowledge.

HTC cab signal (cabinesein)

Next signal in m
Sets the maximum speed in HTC. Choose it before an ETCS → HTC transition to set the signal on entry. A lower signal while too fast gives a warning, then emergency brake after 5 s. BD = HTC out of service, no supervision.

Pantograph and traction system

Now:
Announce m, neutral section m
Hoggynesian conventional lines run on 3 kV DC, high-speed lines on 25 kV AC. A change of system is announced, the pantograph must be down in the neutral section (no traction, the train coasts), then raised again on the new system. Pantograph still up at the section: service brake until you acknowledge.
